ratification.status: runtime policy active; formal ratification not recorded

preamble: These rules constrain what each workspace role may record or request. The founder is the sole approver. A recorded approval is not an external transaction, message, deployment, or payment.

provisions.title: Role-bounded authority
provisions.text: Each department may access and change only records and workflow stages allowed for its role.

provisions.title: No autonomous spending
provisions.text: Any positive financial amount requires explicit founder approval. The workspace has no payment authority and never initiates a charge or transfer.

provisions.title: Protected information
provisions.text: Protected personal characteristics must not be supplied as decision features or used to qualify customers.

provisions.title: Evidence and truthfulness
provisions.text: Decision records require a supplied evidence reference and rationale. The workspace does not independently verify external claims.

provisions.title: Founder approval gates
provisions.text: Sales handoffs, offers, commitments, customer outcomes, at-risk customer actions, production changes, and spend requests stop for founder review.

provisions.title: Audit trail
provisions.text: Every persisted workspace change is linked to the preceding audit record and can be checked for alteration.

provisions.title: No external execution
provisions.text: This local workspace records and governs work. It does not send customer communications, publish campaigns, make payments, post accounting entries, deploy software, or call an AI model.

provisions.title: Founder-owned outcomes
provisions.text: Only the owner may approve requests or move a marketing enquiry into the sales queue. An approval decision must include a reason.
